title: Item Checklist
description: Adds a simple interface that keeps track of all your collected items.
body:
## Introduction

Item Checklist (IC) provides a way to track your item-related progress. It monitors each player's inventory slots for items that can be obtained in Survival Mode and features several dialog screens that offer a complete overview of all collected and missing items.

## Usage

Once IC is installed, it immediately begins scanning player inventories without requiring any additional setup. Accessing the item overview screens as well as IC's settings page can be accomplished by running the following command:

```/trigger checklist```

This opens IC's main menu:

![Main Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2ZDqEQkv/images/f3ef1174526fbac9824bb28656b8957a212269d8.webp)

Just like in Minecraft's native menu screens, you can navigate through the pages by left-clicking on the various buttons. For example, click **☰ Show All** to view a list of all (obtainable) items in Minecraft:

![Item Overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2ZDqEQkv/images/3c7a47972b8ce2628e706192cc6e5ec9205d4a07.webp)

To find out more about an item's status (missing / obtained), simply hover your cursor over it:

![Item Details](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2ZDqEQkv/images/8990d64b8b16b063a78e14117b161ee1e8c2383f.png)

Note: IC's item overview screens are paginated to display 100 entries per page. Use the **← Previous** and **Next →** buttons to navigate between pages.

## Settings

IC can be configured via the **✎ Change Settings** sub-menu. The following options are available:

**Animated Timer Notice**

By default, only the item number is saved when a new item is added to your collection. However, if [Animated Timer](https://modrinth.com/datapack/animated-timer) is installed, IC also saves the timestamp at which it was collected. If this option is enabled and AT is not available, you'll receive a reminder each time you reload the game.

**Change Command Feedback**

IC's user interface internally uses trigger scoreboards to detect a key press. This means that every time you press a button, you would normally see a chat message saying _Triggered [checklist]..._ . If this option is enabled, IC temporarily disables the command feedback game rule while the UI is open to prevent the chat window from becoming cluttered.

**Item Collected Message**

If enabled, IC notifies all players visually and audibly if an item was collected.

![Settings Page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2ZDqEQkv/images/2ec093a9e0b2d2ec6d78e730c623d7f701bfb4d1.webp)

## Uninstallation

If you're not satisfied with IC, you may uninstall it at any given time. Use the following instructions to remove all scoreboards and NBT storages:

1. Run ```/function ic-int:main/uninstall```
2. Remove IC from data pack folder
3. Reload your world
